verdict.rationale: Lium's docs state that an agent can do everything on Lium with no browser, including signup, funding, renting, connecting and removing pods. This is backed by a published OpenAPI spec, a one-call API signup, rent-by-spec endpoints and scoped API keys. The probe 404s were on docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of UI/API parity, and explicit API coverage of UI features such as volumes, clusters, Jupyter and backups.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
fingerprint signup: one call to `POST /auth/signup`, no email, no password, no confirmation link.
rent-by-spec (`POST /executors/rent-by-spec`) that rents the cheapest node matching a GPU spec under a `max_price_per_gpu_hour` ceiling
